messages:
maya: starting final swingback for blue->green in eu-west — change window 14:00-14:20 UTC. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 12m stages and 60s probe pings. primary checks: 95p latency, error-rate, active connections. who’s on watch for rollback?

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout started for release/edge-3.4.1. canary weight=10%. health probes active. notify-channel=eng-releases.

otto: on it — will watch latency and 5xx. i'll set a short-lived dashboard at /dash/quick-swing to track p50/p95 and 5xx rate.

liam: small heads-up: session-affinity TTL is 30s for this route; long-poll clients might skew during transitions. recommend adding 2m drain at each step for managed sessions.

anya: can we pin fallback to release/edge-3.3.x in case we need a fast revert? router supports a pinned-route `edge-legacy` that we can flip to 100% if needed.

sam-platform: preflight checks done: warm pool primed (10 nodes), cold-starts < 2s, active conn baseline captured. I added an extra 2 nodes to the warm pool for eu-west.

oncall-jess: +1 on rollback criteria: abort if 5xx >= 1.0% sustained over 3 probes OR p95 > baseline*2 for 2 consecutive minutes. i'll be on standby.

deploy-bot: canary 10% passed 5m. moving to 50% now. routing weights: green=50, blue=50.

maya: copying probes and thresholds into thread for visibility:```
probe: curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://edge.eu-west/api/health
success_criteria: code==200
latency_probe: ping p95 < 250ms
abort_conditions: 5xx_rate >= 1.0% for 3 probes OR p95 > baseline*2 for 2m
```

otto: seeing a small blip — 5xx at 0.6% peak on one instance at +50%. correlating with SPOOL eviction logs. tailing logs now.

liam: i see traces pointing to worker eviction during heavy GC. could be due to the new runtime flags in 3.4.1. suggest hold and swing back to 10% while we investigate.

maya: hold decision: revert to 10% and pause rollout. anyone object?

oncall-jess: agree with revert, safety-first. i'll keep paging rules active.

deploy-bot: executing partial rollback — routing weights set: green=10, blue=90. canary mode paused.

maya: otto, can you paste the log snippet?

otto: logs:```
[2026-07-15T14:06:12Z] worker=evict id=7d4f msg="evicting idle worker" duration=3s
[2026-07-15T14:06:13Z] http 500 path=/generate service=edge instance=i-0abc msg="request timeout"
```

liam: filed INC-2026-82 for the timeout spikes, attaching traces and heap profiles. root cause candidate: GC threshold bump in runtime flag `--max-live=512m`. reverting that flag for next deploy.

anya: noted. we should also adjust the rollout plan: add 3m extra warm drain and extend canary to 10m per stage. plus pre-warm of session-cache.

sam-platform: i've queued the config change for the warm drain and pre-warm. will push a test deploy to shadow for 30m before full attempt.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. current routing weights: green=10, blue=90. all health probes stable.

maya: thanks everyone. final actions: 1) postmortem/incidence notes in #postmortems after incident triage, 2) reschedule swingback for tomorrow 14:00 UTC with updated rollout (longer canary, extra warm pool), 3) pin `edge-legacy` as fast fallback. anyone want to add items?

oncall-jess: add alert tuning to avoid noisy short-lived spikes: increase probe smoothing to 3 windows.

otto: will run a targetted load test against 3.4.1 with GC flag removed and share results.

maya: excellent. closing thread for the moment. deploy-bot: please post final status to #deploy-logs and attach weight-change diff. :thumbsup:
